comment: Season definitions for the Continuous Model League. Seasons give the never-frozen league narrative shape: 4-week arcs with a champion, a theme, and an archive. Computed against league state — no league-code changes required.

current.name: Genesis
current.theme: Ten walk in. The league learns what it's made of. The first retirements, the first recruits, the first feedback class — every record is a first.
current.champion_rule: Highest L0 (zero-shot) rating at season end; ties broken by win rate, then matches played.
